welcome.title: Welcome to
welcome.tagline: The same engine and the same plugins as the <cli>phoson-cli</cli>, now on your desktop.

providers.title: Your providers
providers.body: Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter… or a local model with vLLM.

skills.title: Agent skills
skills.body: Tools, MCP, plugins, sub-agents and branchable sessions.

storage.title: Everything in ~/.phoson
storage.body: The same config and sessions as the CLI: nothing duplicated.

provider.title: Choose a provider
provider.body: Your key is saved to <path>~/.phoson/config.toml</path> and never shown again.

model.title: Choose your models
model.listError: Couldn't list the provider's models; type the model id instead.
model.subagentNote: The <sub>sub-agent</sub> is the one that runs tools in parallel.

typeId.main: Or type the id for the main model
typeId.sub: Or type the id for the sub-agents

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.body: You can change these anytime from Settings.

safeMode.title: Safe mode
safeMode.body: Asks for confirmation before running commands (bash) and other sensitive actions.

done.title: All set
done.tryPrompt: Try this: <prompt>Show me a demo of everything you can render.</prompt>
